headline: Ancient Roman shipwreck discovered off Sicily coast
summary: Italy says an underwater find off Sicily may be one of its most important archaeological discoveries in years.
script: Italy says a Roman shipwreck found off Sicily may be one of its most important underwater discoveries in years. Barnacle-crusted jars were found on the seabed, opening a new window into ancient trade.
